system.description: • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a scaling damage die (1d6 at 1st level, rising to 4d6 at 23rd — see the Rogue Progression Table) against an aware-but-unsuspecting target, once per round. Usable at range within 30ft, doesn't require a prior stealth check, can't combine with Back Attack. A target is unsuspecting if it cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is in melee with one of your allies and not with you.

activities.name: Sneak Attack
activities.text: Gain Advantage and add the Sneak Attack die against an unsuspecting target within 30ft; see the Rogue Progression Table for the dice.

rules.when: Sneak Attack vs an unsuspecting target (cannot see you, has not acted yet, or in melee with an ally and not you)

rules.value: Sneak Attack: add 1d6 to 4d6 by level (Rogue Progression Table), once per round.
